title: Important: cockpit-machines security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
Cockpit component for managing libvirt virtual machines.

Security Fix(es):

* lodash: lodash: Arbitrary code execution via untrusted input in template imports (CVE-2026-4800)

* lodash: Lodash: Prototype pollution allows deletion of built-in prototype properties via array path bypass (CVE-2026-2950)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* CentOS 10 host: Can't create Cockpit virtual machine in Firefox, can create it in Chrome (JIRA:Rocky Linux-146122)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

Additional Changes:

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Rocky Linux 10 Release Notes linked from the References section.
